Active
[Active - Press] Scorching Dragon Release: Creates an independent avatar. Use Shift + the skill key to switch sub-modes.
Clone Mode: Switch control between the main body and an avatar, leaving a new avatar at the original location.
Fusion Mode: Recall an avatar, causing it to disappear.
Costs 50,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 60 seconds. Up to 5 avatars can be summoned; exceeding this limit replaces the earliest summoned avatar.

[Active - Press] Scorching Excitation:
Increases movement speed.
Increases attack speed.
Increases skill casting speed.
Increases fire and scorching damage.
Avatars summoned by Scorching Dragon Release receive the same enhancements.
Duration: 5 minutes. Cooldown: 300 seconds. Costs 10,000 Magicules.

[Active - Press] Dimensional Leap: Use Shift + the skill key to switch sub-modes.
Arrival Mode (avatars 1, 2, 3, 4, 5): Move from the main body's location to the selected avatar.
Swap Mode (avatars 1, 2, 3, 4, 5): Exchange the positions of the main body and the selected avatar.
Costs 4,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

[Active - Hold, Weapon Required] Scorching Dragon Hegemony · Accelerated Excitation: While holding a weapon, hold the skill key for 5 seconds, then slash to deal 300 fire damage.
Costs 20,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 600 seconds.

Passive
Scorching Domination:
Increases fire damage.
Greatly resists fire attacks.
Ordinary fire cannot harm the player.
Adds the fire attribute to the player's attacks.
Provides fire-element skills.

Multidimensional Barrier:
Provides resistance to physical attacks, immunity to fire, and resistance to elemental attacks.

Ultimate Skill: Michael, Angel of Locks. Wields key and halberd forms to control seals, space, and gravity.

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Eloah: Grants 50 Armor Points and immunity to Severance, leaving a trail of stardust behind the user.

[True Passive] Hits apply Spatial Suppression for 10 seconds.

[True Passive] Targets affected by Seal Marks have their movement speed reduced by 10% and cannot use teleportation abilities.

[Passive, Toggle] King's Presence: Enemies within the radius receive Weakness I, Slowness I, and Blindness I. Allies within the same radius receive Strength I and Resistance II.

Active
[Mode 1] Summon: Key Form
Summons the weapon in key form. The key always has Energy Drain II and Holy Weapon III.

[Mode 2] Segva: The Key of Sealing
Each hit applies 1 Seal Mark. Once a target has 3 marks, looking directly at them for 5 continuous seconds disables all of their temporary abilities for 5 seconds. Seal Marks last for 1 minute.
Costs 15,000 MP per use. Cooldown: 8 seconds on a hit, 5 seconds on a miss, and 130 seconds after completing the seal.

[Mode 3] Lataib: The Key of Unleashing
Opens holes in space that fire projectiles, such as blocks, at enemies. Deals gravity damage without harming the user. Sneaking allows a spatial gate to be opened.
Costs 10,000 MP, lasts for 20 seconds, and has a range of 15 blocks. Deals 75 damage every 20 ticks (1 second). Cooldown: 8 seconds. The holes disappear after 20 seconds.

[Mode 4] Lataib: Spatial Storage
Opens spatial storage with a stack limit of 999 instead of 64. Double-chest sized, with 2 pages.

[Mode 5] Lataib: Spatial Severance
Requires holding Michael's second form. Launches a spatial attack projectile that deals 500 damage, increased to 650 with Mastery, and applies Severance.
Range: 9 blocks, increased to 14 with Mastery. Costs 35,000 MP. Cooldown: 5 seconds, reduced to 3 with Mastery.

[Mode 6] Shifuru: The Key of Release
Releases Michael's true form, transforming the key into a Chinese halberd. Using it again restores key form. Costs 10,000 MP and requires learning.
The halberd always has Energy Steal III, Barrier Piercing X, Holy Weapon III, and Soul Eater.
Holding it for 10 seconds forms a wormhole behind the user. When the 10 seconds end, smaller holes open around the user and rain down small meteors, while a huge hole opens in the sky and drops a giant meteor. The sky fills with stars. Deals spatial and gravity damage.

[Mode 7] Jerez: The Key of Solution
Decomposes targets hit, reducing their Armor Points by 60%, and applies Severance.
Costs 40,000 MP. Cooldown: 10 seconds, reduced to 8 with Mastery.

[Mode 8] Keter: The Key of Crown
Fires a light-purple beam that deals gravity damage. Casting time: 50 ticks (2.5 seconds). Consumes 750 MP every 20 ticks (1 second) and deals 100 damage every 10 ticks (0.5 seconds).
Range: 24 blocks, increased to 30 with Mastery.
Reach 1000 Mischief mastery and accumulate evolution records of 100 explosions, 20 golden apples eaten (enchanted included), and 500000 blocks moved. Evolution replaces Mischief with Great Sage.
Reach 1000 Mischief mastery and accumulate evolution records of 100 explosions, 20 golden apples eaten (enchanted included), and 500000 blocks moved. Evolution replaces Mischief with Great Sage.

Information
Passive: Toggle

"The judge has spoken. Your verdict stands" 

Passive

[Passive, Toggle] Reality Breaker - The user reduces Spatial Damage by 30% (50% when mastered). The user's adds Spatial Damage equal to 0.75x the attack damage of the user. This doesn't stack with Magic Aura.

[Passive, In-SLot] Limiter Breaker - While this skill is in-slot, the user can push skills over their maximum powerscale for Battlewills and Magics by 5. When mastered, it is by 10.

Actives

[Acitve, Press] Bullet Break Storm - The user can charge a series of Magic Bullets and fire it at a target. It cost 50 AP and 50 MP per 1.5 seconds and has a maximum scale of 15 (This can be effected by Power Break). It deals 25 Spatial Damage and 25 Mystic Damage per level. It requires a scale of 3 to be able to gain mastery points. The attack starts with three magic bullets, and gains an additional magic bullet every 5 Power Scale.

[Active, Press] Limitless World - The user pulls themselves and all non-allied targets into their Limitless World. Within this Limitless World, the world prevents teleportation. The user deals bonus physical damage, increased by 7.5% every time they hit a target. After increasing by 30%, the user begins to have 500 Magicules x the Boosted Amount each time they hit a target. If the user has Nihility, the target will instead be taking Void Damage in place of the bonus physical damage. This will take 1/2 the damage dealt as the Nihility Price per hit.

[Active, In-Slot] Dimensional Rupture - While this mode is in-slot, the user reduces all Spatial Damage by 50%, can bypass Distortion Field and Fault Field and becomes immune to severance.

[Active, In-Slot]Nihility Supply (Requires Mastery) - While the user can deal Spatial Damage to generate Nihility. Their Nihility can scale up to 10,000 points before the user begins to take 50 Void Damage a second until it is decreased below 10,000. The user can have a maximum of 25,000 Nihility.
